title: Scoundry
description: Scoundry is a character-creator web-app for Blades in the Dark. Manage your character sheets and track progress. Features offline sharing/saving, and localizations to varying degrees in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, and Chinese.

title: Grimoire
description: Grimoire is a character-creator web-app for Grimwild and features character sheet creation using a dynamic step-by-step form for the twelve core character classes in the game. Additionally, it streamlines your character creation process with built-in name generators and random tables.
